title: ADNOC drilling-report Q&A system
summary: An NLP question-answering system over the drilling reports produced during oil and gas operations, so engineers can query them in natural language. The reports themselves are confidential, so the working dataset is manufactured: `Synthetic_Data_Generation.ipynb` builds a `SingleTableMetadata` and fits a `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` on the structured drilling fields. SDV's copula synthesizer is run to stand in for operational data that cannot be published.

title: DP data generation with missing data

Its baselines are SmartNoise, carried in-tree: `snsynth/pytorch/nn/dpctgan.py` declares `class DPCTGAN(CTGANSynthesizer)` and `patectgan.py` imports the same class, over a preprocessor built on RDT's `OneHotEncoder`, with `ctgan==0.4.3` and `rdt==0.5.3` pinned. CTGAN's source arrives vendored through SmartNoise as the DP baselines under study.

title: Data-centric ensemble synthetic data
